feedTitle: Shipping forecast for the North Irish Sea

items.title: Shipping forecast updated as of 2 October 2026 4:32am
items.description:
##Current shipping forecast##

Valid for 24 HoursIssued on Friday, 02 October 2026 at 4:15am by Ronaldsway Met Office
##Warning##

Strong winds.


##Synopsis##

Low pressure near Iceland will bring fronts through the day.


##Wind##

South or southwest 4 or 5, gradually increasing 5 or 6 by early afternoon, then becoming 5 to 7 for a time late afternoon and early evening. Veering west 4 or 5 through the evening, then further decreasing 3 or 4 late in the night into Saturday.


##State of Sea##

Moderate, becoming moderate or rough for a time during the late afternoon and evening. Locally slight in Liverpool Bay.


##Weather##

Showers or rain until later.


##Visibility##

Good, occasionally moderate or poor in showers or rain.


##Outlook for the following 24 hours##


##Wind##

West 3 or 4, gradually backing south or southwest through Saturday. Increasing 4, occasionally 5, late in the night into Sunday.


##State of Sea##

Slight.


##Weather##

Fair.


##Visibility##

Good.
